_comment: Field corrections to the ACO 2022 Darwin Core archive (data/sources/aco.json), applied by common.checklist() for every step that reads the list. Key = normalised ACO scientific name. Grallaria saturata / G. saltuensis: the archive's vernacularName values are swapped (saturata = Equatorial Antpitta, saltuensis = Perijá Antpitta, as in SACC and eBird/Clements). Oxyura jamaicensis: remapped to Andean Duck O. ferruginea (aco_to_ebird.json), a resident; the uncertain boreal-migrant part of the ACO status belongs to North American Ruddy Duck, which is not in the list. Setophaga petechia: after the eBird/Clements 2025 split the ACO record is Mangrove Yellow Warbler (resident on the coasts); the boreal migrants of the ACO status are Northern Yellow Warbler S. aestiva (clements2025.json).

status.raw: Residente (ACO 2022: «Migratorio Boreal? - Residente»; северные мигранты — это Ruddy Duck, O. jamaicensis в узком смысле)
